```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the completed results and shared report controls.
source("report-setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())
```

The validated manifests record the target cohorts, GWAS studies, reference resources,
and phenotype models used in the run. Raw genotype and raw phenotype values are not
displayed on this page.

## Target cohorts

```{r}
# Display the validated target manifest with its download.
buttonROW(fileBUTTON("target_manifest.validated.tsv", "Download target manifest"))
tableVIEW(targetMANIFEST, "Validated target cohorts.")
```

## GWAS studies

```{r}
# Display the validated GWAS manifest with its download.
buttonROW(fileBUTTON("gwas_manifest.validated.tsv", "Download GWAS manifest"))
tableVIEW(gwasMANIFEST, "Validated GWAS studies and source-column mappings.")
```

## Reference resources

```{r}
# Display the validated reference manifest with its download.
buttonROW(fileBUTTON("reference_manifest.validated.tsv", "Download reference manifest"))
tableVIEW(referenceMANIFEST, "Validated linkage-disequilibrium and annotation resources.")
```

## Phenotype models

```{r}
# Display the prespecified phenotype models when they were supplied.
if (nrow(phenotypeMANIFEST) > 0L) {
  buttonROW(fileBUTTON("phenotype_models.validated.tsv", "Download phenotype models"))
  tableVIEW(phenotypeMANIFEST, "Prespecified phenotype models.")
}
```

## Parameters and input identity

```{r}
# Provide the resolved parameters and immutable input checksums.
buttonROW(
  fileBUTTON("resolved_params.yaml", "Download resolved parameters"),
  fileBUTTON("input_checksums.tsv", "Download input checksums")
)
tableVIEW(checksum, "SHA-256 input checksums.")
```
